description: Small hand-labelled retrieval set. Notes are written like real personal notes; queries are what someone might ask weeks later. 'paraphrase' queries share almost no words with the note they should find; 'exact' queries use a specific name or term from the note.

notes.title: DuckDB tip
notes.body: union_by_name=true makes DuckDB open every file at once. With thousands of JSON files that blew past the memory limit. Read one base model instead.

notes.title: dbt incremental models
notes.body: Use delete+insert with a unique key when late-arriving rows can change. Merge is fine on warehouses that support it. Always add a full-refresh escape hatch.

notes.title: Airflow TaskFlow API
notes.body: Decorate Python functions with @task and return values pass between tasks via XCom automatically. Much cleaner than PythonOperator plus manual xcom_pull.

notes.title: Kafka consumer groups
notes.body: Each partition is read by exactly one consumer in a group. More consumers than partitions means some sit idle. Rebalancing happens when members join or leave.

notes.title: Brier score
notes.body: Mean squared error between predicted probabilities and 0/1 outcomes. Lower is better; always compare against a baseline that predicts the base rate.

notes.title: Doubly robust estimation
notes.body: Combine an outcome model and a propensity model. The estimate stays consistent if either one is right. Use cross-fitting to avoid overfitting bias.

notes.title: Conformal prediction
notes.body: Calibrate prediction intervals on held-out data so coverage matches the target, whatever the model. Split conformal needs only one calibration set.

notes.title: Sample size for A/B tests
notes.body: Required units grow with variance and shrink with the square of the effect. Halving the detectable effect needs four times the traffic. Run A/A tests first.

notes.title: CUPED
notes.body: Regress the outcome on a pre-experiment covariate and analyse the residual. Variance falls by the squared correlation, so the test needs fewer users.

notes.title: Point-in-time features
notes.body: Only use information available at prediction time. Seller history must count orders delivered before checkout, or the model sees the future.

notes.title: Git commits not on my profile
notes.body: GitHub only links commits whose author email is on the account. Set user.email globally and amend with --reset-author.

notes.title: pytest picked the wrong Python
notes.body: With the conda base env active, the pytest command came from anaconda instead of the venv. conda deactivate, recreate the venv, and use python -m pytest.

notes.title: MCP tool annotations
notes.body: readOnlyHint, destructiveHint and idempotentHint let clients auto-approve safe tools and ask before dangerous ones.

notes.title: Sanitising full-text queries
notes.body: Quote every token before passing user input to SQLite FTS5 so stray quotes or AND/OR/NEAR cannot break or change the query.

notes.title: Weeknight pasta
notes.body: Garlic, chilli flakes and olive oil, then toss with spaghetti and a splash of the cooking water. Ten minutes.

notes.title: Sourdough starter
notes.body: Feed equal weights of flour and water daily. It is ready when it doubles within six hours and smells tangy, not like nail polish.

notes.title: Half marathon plan
notes.body: Three easy runs, one tempo and one long run a week. Increase the long run by about ten percent weekly, with a lighter week every fourth.

notes.title: Sleep routine
notes.body: No screens for the last half hour, same wake-up time on weekends, and keep the bedroom cool.

notes.title: Passport renewal
notes.body: Renew at least six months before it expires; some countries refuse entry with less validity. Keep the application receipt number to track status online.

notes.title: Apartment lease renewal
notes.body: Landlord needs 60 days notice before the lease ends. Ask about a rent freeze in exchange for signing for 18 months.

notes.title: Behavioural interview answers
notes.body: Situation, task, action, result. Keep the action part longest and say I, not we. Prepare one story about a failure.

notes.title: Resume bullet formula
notes.body: What you built, the technology, who it helped, and a result you can explain in an interview. Never invent numbers.

notes.title: Negotiating an offer
notes.body: Let them name a number first, ask for time to consider, and negotiate the total package including signing bonus and start date.

notes.title: Deploying a Streamlit app
notes.body: Push to GitHub, point share.streamlit.io at the repo and the app file, and keep a requirements.txt next to the app.

notes.title: Smaller Docker images
notes.body: Copy the dependency file and install before copying source, so code changes do not bust the cache. Use slim base images and multi-stage builds.

notes.title: When a database index helps
notes.body: Indexes speed up selective lookups and joins but slow down writes. Check the query plan before adding one.

notes.title: SQL window functions
notes.body: row_number over a partition picks the latest record per key. qualify filters on it without a subquery in DuckDB and Snowflake.

notes.title: Chunking for RAG
notes.body: Split long documents into overlapping passages so each embedding covers one topic. Too large blurs topics, too small loses context.

notes.title: Cutting LLM API costs
notes.body: Put stable instructions first so the provider can cache the prompt prefix, and batch requests that are not urgent.

notes.title: Deep Work notes
notes.body: Schedule long blocks without notifications for hard thinking. Shallow tasks expand to fill the time you give them.

notes.title: Booking flights home
notes.body: Holiday fares were lowest booking about seven weeks ahead, flying mid-week, with one stop.

notes.title: Monthly budget
notes.body: Rent first, then groceries and transit. Move savings automatically on payday so it never feels available to spend.
